body.kept: Whole, at the author's word, these being few: all three of the author's utterances and the one answer given before they asked for this keeping. It is the conversation of the fifth session going on after that session was committed, so its order starts again. The answer lost its headings and list marks here, each line a paragraph. The answer that closes the session came after this commit and is not kept. Whether each came spoken or typed is the session's own reading; one word the dictation misheard is corrected, with what it wrote kept on the word. Between the first utterance here and what the fifth asked for, the session did the work: commit 1087e81 brought the code to the store, and 27dea0c brought 53 briefs to what stands. Three reviews by fresh agents took about 640,000 tokens with the search's port. It was used in a browser on loopback only, never timed on a real host. Tests typing into the real search found that a brief could not be found by its name, mended with the native Named.
